caption: The drawing depicts a large, beige stoneware crock with two side handles and a wide mouth, featuring blue decorative accents. The central focus of the crock is a painted blue bird with a long tail and distinct plumage, perched on a branch, rendered prominently on the front surface of the vessel. Above this painted decoration, there is an inscription in capital letters that reads "J.J. WANDS / OLEAN, N.Y." as well as a number "4," all in blue. The drawing is bordered by a penciled rectangular frame, with two additional inset illustrations: one in the upper left corner showing a detailed close-up of the blue bird decoration, and another in the bottom right corner depicting a close-up of the crock’s rim and handle. The artist’s name, "Yolande DeLasser," is written in neat, capitalized letters at the bottom left of the drawing. The overall composition is executed in muted tones of beige, brown, and deep blue, with careful shading to convey the three-dimensional form and texture of the crock.
title: Jar
